contexts.text: The farina of fine flour () = the Spiritual and the Celestial then with the Lord. AC 2183.
The fine flour (in the meat-offering) = the Spiritual of it.
Fine flour made into cakes represented the same as bread...
Fine flour (in the bread of faces) = the same as the farina of fine flour; namely, the Celestial and its Spiritual.
The affections of truth and good of the Ancient Church are signified by fine flour, honey and oil ().
Fine flour soaked () = the celestial things of faith.
Fine flour (in the meat-offering) = charity towards the neighbour.
Fine flour () = what is spiritual. ( = truth. AE 617:7. AE 619:11.)
Wheat = good; and fine flour, its truth.
With fine flour of wheat shalt thou make them () = the truth which is from Divine good. Fine flour = truth.
That fine flour, and also meal = the truth which is from good. Illustrated. AC 1182. AC 10136. AC 10540:3.
Fine flour (in the meat-offering) = genuine truth.
Fine flour = truth from spiritual good, because it is from wheat, by which is signified spiritual good. Illustrated.
